nightCard.featuredLine: Tonight her grandson's ferry leaves at half past.
lines: Market reopens tonight, with a line on to Hillside. The tree is still down between Old Town and Hillside.
A pickup tonight: Dev is waiting at Old Town. The train has to collect him before it can drop him off.
Not everyone will make it home on time.
nightCard.footnote: Market reopens at quarter past, with a ribbon to cut.

platform.headline: The ferry leaves at half past.
platform.coach: One question tonight. Then promise one of them. Dev boards at Old Town, so pass Old Town before Market.

passengers.name: Agnes
passengers.platform: The ferry's at half past. He's eight. He won't remember me waving, but I will.
passengers.ask: His mum's taking him over the water for good. The scarf's so he has something of mine.

onTime.line: She found him at the rail. She wound the scarf round him twice, and the boat pulled out.
onTime.logLine: She wound the scarf round him twice.

late.line: The ferry was lights on the water. She held the scarf up anyway.
late.carry: Thursday Agnes posts the scarf instead. The post boat takes parcels until twenty-five past.

notReached.line: She heard the horn from the platform at Central.
notReached.carry: Thursday Agnes posts the scarf instead. The post boat takes parcels until twenty-five past.

passengers.name: Priya
passengers.platform: Flyers for Thursday. Every lamppost in Old Town before the glue freezes.
passengers.ask: If nobody comes on Thursday, at least I'll know it wasn't the flyers.

onTime.line: Forty flyers, forty lampposts. She saved one for your cab.

late.line: Half the lampposts. She did the rest by torchlight.

notReached.line: She taped the flyers up at Central instead. Nobody from Old Town will see them.

passengers.name: Wen
passengers.platform: Brought the crossword. He does the across, I do the down.
passengers.planQuote: He does the across, I do the down.
passengers.ask: The nurse rang. He's flagging, so ten past or he'll be asleep. Friday he'll have a cake if he's up to it.

onTime.line: They did eleven across together. He got it first.

late.line: He'd gone to sleep. She filled in the across for him, in his handwriting.

notReached.line: She did the crossword alone on the train. She left the across blank.

passengers.name: Tomás
passengers.platform: Kept on. They want me in by quarter to now, every night.
passengers.planQuote: In by quarter to, every night.
passengers.ask: Friday the bakery does the big order for the line's closing party. I've the recipe in my head.

onTime.line: In with time to spare. He's teaching the new lad the rye.

late.line: Ten minutes. The manager just wrote it down.

notReached.line: He didn't make it. He phoned, and they said fine, in that voice.

passengers.name: Dev
passengers.platform: Rang ahead: I'll be on the library steps at Old Town. Market by ten to, night shift.
passengers.planQuote: Market by ten to. Night shift.
passengers.ask: First in my family at uni. Mum thinks I'm asleep. I stack shelves till six so she doesn't have to.

onTime.line: He clocked on with a minute spare. The supervisor didn't look up, which is the best kind of night.

late.line: Docked half an hour. He revised his notes on the back of the docking slip.

notReached.line: He walked from the last stop with his headphones in. The album lasted the whole way.

variants.platform: Grey, in the end. He'll have to like grey. The ferry's at half past.
Band's letting me play the song for them tonight. If they like it, it's back in.
variants.planQuote: One chance to win the song back.

onTime.line: She played it once through. The drummer just nodded. It's back in.

late.line: They'd packed up. She played it to the empty room anyway.

notReached.line: She sang it into a voice memo and sent it. No reply yet.

variants.platform: He didn't wake. That's all right.
variants.planQuote: He didn't wake. That's all right.

variants.platform: Friday's my last shift. Still want to do them right.

onTime.line: He did the shift right. Nobody thanked him, but he knew.

variants.platform: You said you'd get me there. I know it wasn't the train's fault. Still.
variants.planQuote: You said you'd get me there.

coach.text: Tonight is Agnes's grandson's ferry. You promised {promised}. Click a glowing station to start.
Three is the most anyone can do tonight, and every way to get three leaves Agnes waiting. Saving her costs someone else.
You promised {promised}. On this route, they won't make it.
Two home. {waiting} would wait. Is it worth it? Only you can say.

logbook.tomorrow: Thursday is Priya's first real gig. She's on at quarter past.
